rag.text:
Test: TC-2781 — Box Module - Board - Card Views - Resizing card view fields
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-24 Box Module - Board - Card Views
Labels: can_be_automated, teamsmile

Steps:
1. Navigate to Box configuration of boxName and go to Card Views page under Board tab.
   Data: boxName: TC-2781 Box Module - Board - Card Views - Resizing card view fields
   Expected: Card Views page is opened correctly. Card views are visible:
- Essentials
- Agile
- Teams
2. Click on cardViewName.
   Data: cardViewName: Essentials
   Expected: Card view creator page for Essentials is opened. Buttons 'Save', 'Discard changes' and 'Delete' are inactive.
Fields are displayed:
- Icon
- Key
- Status
- Assignee
- Priority
- Summary
- Reporter
3. Hover over the space on the bottom side of the fieldName on the task card and click on the ellipsis icon. Drag the cursor down to the point where the original size of the field is doubled and drop it.
   Data: fieldName: Summary
   Expected: Summary field has doubled its original size. Buttons 'Save' and  'Discard changes' are active. 'Delete' button is still inactive. 
Fields are displayed:
- Icon
- Key
- Status
- Assignee
- Priority
- Summary
- Reporter
4. Click Save button
   Expected: The change has been saved. Buttons 'Save', 'Discard changes' and 'Delete' are inactive.
5. Hover over the space on the bottom side of the fieldName on the task card and click on the ellipsis icon. Drag the cursor up to the point where the size of the field is half of the previous size and drop it.
   Data: fieldName: Summary
   Expected: Summary field is half of the previous size. Buttons 'Save' and  'Discard changes' are active. 'Delete' button is still inactive.
6. Click Discard changes
   Expected: The change has been discarded. Buttons 'Save', 'Discard changes' and 'Delete' are inactive.
